record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare REFLECT: Espurr (1 star) and Meowstic male (2 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (the reflect factor index) and stats. Espurr also declares the passive ESPURR, which is not covered here. Meowstic female and other units are not covered.
record.summary: Self-targeted status cast: the caster gains the reflect status for 3000 ms (stars 1-3; 5000 ms from 4 stars) via Status.triggerReflect. While reflect is active, every PHYSICAL hit it receives is fully negated (takenDamage 0). Unless the attacker holds Protective Pads or the hit is itself a retaliation, the attacker takes SPECIAL damage equal to round(factor x the incoming damage x (1 + the reflector's AP/100) x critPower if the reflector's ABILITY_CRIT roll succeeds), factor 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 / 1.5 by the reflector's stars (so 0.5 for Espurr, 0.75 for Meowstic). No damage is dealt by the cast itself. Recasting while active only extends the timer to the larger value.

targeting.who: the caster itself; the cast target is only the generic requiresTarget gate
targeting.note: The strategy never reads target. Reflected damage goes to whoever attacks the reflecting unit with PHYSICAL damage during the window.

effects.scaling: No AP scaling and no duration reduction: triggerReflect(timer) stores the timer as is. The cooldown only rises (if timer > current, replace); a second cast does not stack.
effects.resolution: reflect = true until the cooldown counted down by updateReflect reaches 0. Not blocked by Rune Protect (triggerReflect has no runeProtect check). Ended early by RAGING_BULL, BRICK_BREAK or SHADOW_FORCE against the unit.

effects.target: the attacker of any PHYSICAL hit on the reflecting unit

declaredRaw.label: reflect factor by the reflecting unit's stars (raw multiplier of the incoming damage)

effects.scaling: reflected = Math.round(factor x damage x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if reflectCrit)); damage is the incoming physical figure after the enraged / field / weather / Hisuian Typhlosion / Sheer Cold multipliers and BEFORE the defense division; AP and crit are the reflecting unit's own; reflectCrit needs the ABILITY_CRIT effect and a roll of its critChance.
effects.resolution: the reflected figure is sent to attacker.handleDamage as SPECIAL, so it is then reduced by the attacker's SPE_DEF (armor reduction halves it), has minimum 1 and can hit a shield. Skipped (nothing reflected) if the attacker holds Protective Pads, or the hit is a retaliation (isRetaliation). In every case the original physical hit returns takenDamage 0 and deals nothing to the reflecting unit. A Human-synergy heal effect from the reflected damage is also triggered (not traced further).

statusEffects: reflect on the caster, 3000 ms (stars 1-3) / 5000 ms (4+)

starBehavior.note: The duration table is indexed by the casting entity's stars (3000 for stars 1-3, 5000 from star 4 and as the ?? fallback); the reflect factor table in handleDamage is indexed by the reflecting entity's stars (0.5 / 0.75 / 1 / 1.5). The 3- and 4-star columns are not reachable by the two listed units' factory star counts.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0) and calls triggerReflect again; the timer is replaced only when the new duration exceeds the remaining one, so a recast during the window refreshes it up to the full duration but does not add.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: reflect for 3000 ms; reflect factor 0.5 (Espurr) / 0.75 (Meowstic). The cast has no damage of its own. Reflected damage = round(factor x pre-defense incoming physical damage x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit); the attacker then applies its own SPE_DEF reduction (minimum 1, shield first), so the damage it actually loses is smaller than the figure sent. The reflecting unit takes 0 from each physical hit while reflect is active, even when Protective Pads or retaliation stop the reflection. No heal, PP gain or shield is created by the ability itself.
